mxCell.value: Chen notation: rectangle = entity, ellipse = attribute, diamond = relationship, underlined attribute = primary key

Legend
underlined = primary key
1 / M labels = cardinality
Orange ellipses = relationship attributes
Layer colors are for readability only

Modeling choices
• SQL associative tables are rendered as ER relationships when they primarily express linkage plus linkage attributes.
• Audit / queue tables remain entities because they have independent lifecycle and review semantics.
• Views/materialized views are excluded from the ER model.
